Hi all,

Thanks again for hosting us — really productive two days. Attaching the initial draft of the consolidated notes (see attachment: 20260210-acme-workshop-notes-draft.pdf). I want to lock down three quick items so we can close the loop by EOD Friday:  

1) Notes distribution: please review the attached draft and reply with edits or comments. Once we have one round of edits, I will publish the final notes to the shared folder and send to the full attendee list.

2) Action-item tracker: Jordan, can you own creating the canonical action tracker (spreadsheet in Drive) and make sure each item has an owner + SLA? Marcus — please review tech follow-ups and mark priority.

3) Travel & expense: Sarah/Tom, for any travel expenses from your side, please send expense receipts to finance@acme-enterprises.com as usual and cc me; Redwood will process partner reimbursements per our SOW. I’ve attached the Redwood expense template for convenience (expense-forms.xlsx).

Quick asks / deadlines: please send edits to the notes or confirm "no edits" by Thursday 2/12 COB; action tracker live by Friday 2/13 12pm PT.

If there are any procurement or legal items that need a different cadence, flag them here and I’ll loop in the right folks.

Thanks — Grace
